summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for IrishCareConnect:
- Renaming app to IrishCareConnect across metadata, title, and UI.
- Updating resident profile for Mrs. Brimberg at 480 Park (turning 93 this December).
- Configuring care team profiles: Head Nurse Margaret Brady, plus team members Lisa Peters, Fiona Byrne, Helene Cashin, and Pauline Gilroy.
- Shared iPad / Mobile login switcher with 1-tap switch and mobile head nurse access.
- Daily midnight liquid reset with 24-hour hydration tracking and historical daily logs.
- Calendar date picker & Previous/Next day page flipping tabs to review prior shift notes.
- Persistent local storage across dates with backup/restore capabilities.
